newsitem.title: UK: Grampian leaps on confirmation of STV bid.
newsitem.headline: Grampian leaps on confirmation of STV bid.

text.p: Shares in Grampian Television Plc leapt in pre-market trading on Monday as the company confirmed it was in talks with Scottish Media Group Plc which may lead to a merger of the two companies.
Grampian shares were quoted 45p higher at 307-1/2 by 0727 GMT, though no volume was recorded in the stock, while Scottish Media -- owner of Scottish Television -- was up 11-1/2p at 686-1/2.

In a brief statement, the two companies said they had noted press reports on the possibility of an agreed bid by Scottish Media for Grampian and confirmed they were in talks which could lead to an offer for the latter at around 320p per share.
